name: Small TV ESP8684H v2.0
status: experimental; boot, display and isolated Wi-Fi/NTP simulation
limitations: PHY calibration uses compatibility completion flags, not RF signal calculations
Bluetooth and WPA encryption are not implemented
GPIO matrix and IO_MUX route transaction-level SPI/I2C; electrical timing and bit banging are not simulated
No cycle-accurate timing, power consumption, secure boot or flash encryption validation
Snapshot isolates flash writes; live migration and CPU-state snapshots are unsupported
Fixed instruction-count virtual time may lag wall time under CPU load
